settingsModal.title: Settings
settingsModal.languageHelp: Restart not required; UI updates instantly.

appearance.activityBarHelp: Takes effect immediately; icons inside the panel auto-rotate to match the chosen side
appearance.themeModeHelpHeader: Pick the overall aitm color scheme (the terminal's xterm theme auto-switches to the paired dark/light variant)
appearance.themeModeFooter: Takes effect immediately; shortcut ⌘⇧L toggles between dark and light
appearance.sidePanelHelp: Takes effect immediately; when on the same side as the ActivityBar, the ActivityBar stays on the outermost edge
appearance.confirmQuitHelp: Show a confirmation dialog before closing the app; with this off, the red close button / Cmd+Q quits immediately
appearance.restoreSessionHelp: Reopen the tabs, split layout and files from your last session when aitm starts; with this off you always start with a single empty tab
appearance.notificationSoundHelp: Fires system notifications when an AI waits for approval / completes / errors; turning this off keeps notifications silent

terminal.fontFamilyHelp: Pick a preset · or type a CSS font stack
terminal.fontFamilyPlaceholder: CSS font stack, e.g. 'Fira Code', monospace
terminal.fontFamilyFooter: The text field renders in the chosen font — if the glyphs don't change, that font isn't installed; invalid stacks silently fall back to monospace
terminal.themeHelp: Takes effect immediately; colors are the original Dracula / Solarized / One Dark community palettes
terminal.shellDefaultLabel: Default shell path (leave empty to inherit $SHELL)
terminal.shellHelp: Applies to newly opened tabs; existing tabs are unaffected

editor.title: Editor
editor.fontSizeHelp: CodeMirror font size in pixels. Also adjustable with Cmd+= / Cmd+- / Cmd+0 when the editor has focus.

safety.descriptionAfter: calls are auto-approved (no prompt). DESTRUCTIVE commands (e.g. sudo / git push --force) still always prompt — the whitelist cannot override them.
safety.emptyHint: (No entries yet; click the button below to add one)
safety.showBadgeLabel: Show a badge on the tool bubble when auto-approved

privacy.descLine1Prefix: aitm only reports launches / feature usage counts / errors; it
privacy.descLine1Suffix: collect your commands, files, or conversation contents.
privacy.descLine2: Helps the developers see which features are worth investing in. You can turn this off at any time.
privacy.descLine3Prefix: Data is handled by Aptabase (open-source privacy analytics):

browser.resourceBudgetHelp: Each active embedded browser tab uses roughly {{mb}} MB of memory. Collapsing the browser panel destroys every webview at once, restoring memory to zero.
browser.activeLimitHelp: Range {{min}}-{{max}}; tabs above this count → the oldest non-pinned tab auto-suspends to free memory
browser.suspendHelp: Range {{min}}-{{max}} minutes; a non-active, non-pinned tab that's been backgrounded longer than this auto-suspends
browser.currentBudgetHelp: Raising the active limit raises memory usage significantly; 3-5 is the sweet spot. If memory is tight, collapse the browser panel (collapse button on the right of the address bar) to release everything at once.

keybindings.title: Keybindings
keybindings.intro: Click "Edit" and press a new key combination; conflicts are highlighted in red. Changes take effect immediately and persist to settings.toml.
keybindings.conflictWarning: {{count}} shortcut conflict group(s) found; identical keys will trigger only the first matching action.
keybindings.captureDescription: Press the new key combination (Esc to cancel)
